_comment: Hand-authored. Animation groups built from the 33 canonical slots (animation_slots.json). fps is frames per second at speed 1; loop groups repeat until replaced; one-shot groups play once, then switch to 'next' or hold their last frame. 'anchor' names the island_layout anchor the character stands on. Timings follow master plan Phase 4.

workout._comment: Three times the first tuning: a rep every half second, brisk lift and lower.

sleeping._comment: Two drawings, in and out, so the fps sets the breathing: 0.5 is one slow breath every four seconds. The secondary motion below uses the same four seconds, so the lift and the drawing breathe together.

motion._comment: Movement feel (scripts/systems/motion.gd). Distances are stage units (design pixels on the 1920x1080 canvas), times are game seconds. 'travel' is the hop between anchors; 'blend' dissolves one group into the next and eases small frame-to-frame pops; 'secondary' is the breathing laid over the drawn frames so a held pose never freezes dead.

travel._comment: speed sets the duration (distance / speed, clamped); hop is the arc height as a share of the distance; squash is the stretch at the top of the arc; shadow_shrink tightens the shadow while he is airborne.

blend._comment: crossfade covers a group change; groups at or below slow_fps also dissolve between their own frames, so the slow sleep softens from one drawing into the next instead of switching. The dissolve never takes more than half a frame's own time. jitter_px is the biggest frame-to-frame body shift that slides into place instead of jumping, over jitter_ease seconds.

secondary._comment: bob is the lift in stage units over one period, sway the side-to-side, breathe the chest widening as a share of his scale.

frame_overrides._comment: Victory jump is drawn airborne; lift it off the ground by a share of its visible height.
Hunger rumble is drawn about 17% larger than its neighbours in Forms 6-11 (1024x1536 source).
